decoder_stage_scope: Pooled per-eye events joined by exact frame/eye/warp to warm first stereo use. Durations are not summed into stereo latency. Quantiles of telescoping presentation stages are not additive.

drift_analysis.interpretation: Descriptive stage shifts, not additive percentile attribution or a causal scheduling diagnosis. Selected-source reuse is small relative to the bracket-wide age change. Runtime target/submit phase and selected target/readiness phase are separate in each candidate record.

metric: Nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 of first successful encoded stereo submission minus earliest eye receipt; two-second warmup; global prewarm seen-frame history retained.
period_classification: Descriptive 90 Hz band 11000000..11200000 ns; no original policy alteration.

recommendations.choice: Retain closest-target cached-copy as control; do not promote bounded-newest.
recommendations.reason: One bounded run contains focus loss and 72 Hz periods and is excluded from fixed-90 comparisons. The other stays 90 Hz but misses 88 unique stereo Hz. Closest brackets drift substantially; no stable causal selector win is established.

recommendations.choice: Continue native mapped-direct as an opt-in decoder/output investigation, keep cached-copy control.
recommendations.reason: Both output arms have substantial session drift; these four runs do not establish an end-to-end winner. Compare joined decode/copy stages separately. Native VR444 NEON mapped RGBA output is distinct from RRF/RRB LZ4-to-mapped-RGB prototypes.

recommendations.choice: Prioritize default-off publication/pacer diagnostics for the next native integration.
recommendations.reason: Closest bracket age increase is observed chiefly between publication and selection, with target/supply phase changing. This does not establish cause or removability. Diagnostic branch needs synchronized overlay/patch and a fresh build; not present in this APK. Do not take the early pacer trace without its initialization fix.

recommendations.choice: Retain repaired schema-2 trace analysis and preserve all original evidence statuses.
recommendations.reason: Replay validates successful-submission traces; intervening/terminal render attempts remain unrecorded. No original failed historical capture is relabeled.

recommendations.choice: Keep HEVC as a native hardware compression reference, not RGB444 quality equivalence.
recommendations.reason: Actual per-eye streams are 576x640 HEVC Main yuvj420p. No run reaches p95 strictly below 15 ms; traces, samples and these short repeats cannot establish release readiness.

scope: Read-only integrity replay and development triage of ten fixed native headset runs; no new acquisition, optical latency or promotion.
transport: TCP over ADB reverse over wireless ADB; not direct codec Wi-Fi transport.
